errors.evidence: The markers for the MoHD model are squares, not triangles.
The blue line for the MoHD model starts at a value just above 11.0 (approximately 11.05), not 10.9.
At the x-value 1/4, the Eval PPL for the MoHD model is approximately 10.6, not 10.4.
At the x-value 2/4, the Eval PPL for the MoHD model is approximately 10.45, not 10.2.
At the x-value 3/4, the Eval PPL for the MoHD model is at its minimum value of approximately 10.25, not 10.6. The description also incorrectly states the trend is increasing to this point.
The dashed line for the Transformer model is horizontal and constant at approximately 11.6; it does not decrease and finish at 11.5.
